content.text: That check was too clever. I'll replace it with a separate, readable test of the 2-decimal formatting.

input.command:
f=src/test/java/br/com/loja/checkout/CheckoutControllerTest.java
sed -i '33s/.*/        enviar(json).andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(content().json(esperado, JsonCompareMode.STRICT));/' $f
sed -i 's/^import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.ResultActions;/&\nimport org.springframework.test.json.JsonCompareMode;/' $f
sed -i 's/^import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;/import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.allOf;\nimport static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;\n&/' $f
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/src/test/java/br/com/loja/checkout/CheckoutControllerTest.java'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.rindex('}')
s=s[:i]+'''
    @Test
    void valoresEmDinheiroSempreComDuasCasas() throws Exception {
        enviar("""
                {"itens":%s,"modalidadeEntrega":"EXPRESSA","formaPagamento":"PIX",
                 "nivelClube":"OURO","regiao":"SUDESTE"}""".formatted(CAMISETA_TENIS))
                .andExpect(content().string(allOf(
                        containsString("\\"subtotalProdutos\\":409.70"),
                        containsString("\\"descontoCupom\\":0.00"),
                        containsString("\\"frete\\":0.00"))));
    }
}
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
mvn -o verify > /tmp/b.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -E "Tests run:|BUILD|ERROR" /tmp/b.log | tail -5
